motion.note: Heavy crouched crocodile with a huge crest: the game's own battle idle (pm0160_51_00_00001_battlewait01_loop from the user's Legends Z-A pack, 18916_autosave.glb, 24 fps, frames 0.4-52.4 = 52 steps = 2.167 s, last frame a copy of the first), chosen over _10001_ because its pose matches the Mega HOME render / official art (crest fanned upright, arms bent with claws down, wide crouch); _10001_ holds the arms straight out and lets the crest hang back. Moved onto a copy of the textured model (MegaFeraligatr_idle.blend, move_clip.py; rest matrices identical, no scale keys, no object keys).
